notes.title: Bernband officially revealed at PC Gaming Showcase!
notes.notes:
[p]Very special day today as I was finally able to announce my new game to the world! The [b]Bernband[/b] announcement trailer was featured in the PC Gaming Showcase alongside lots of cool games. [/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="yxSl96druSQ;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][p][b]About the game[/b][/p][p]Bernband is a sci-fi exploration sim for people who like to wander. Get lost in an alien city, hang out with locals, see some sights. There’s no goal but to stroll. Where will your feet take you?
[/p][p]If this game seems familiar, that’s because it’s a remake of a project of mine that went somewhat viral back in 2014, also called [url="https://gamejolt.com/games/bernband/34864"]Bernband[/url]. The new Bernband is going to be at least twice the size of the original, with loads of new areas and secrets to discover![/p][p][/p][p]Please feel free to drop a wishlist if you like the look of the project. Thanks so much! :) 
[/p][p]All the best,[/p][p]Tom[/p][p]
[/p]
